_doc: Position-sizing counterfactual matrix over all 303 closed round trips. Sizing cannot change which trades happened or their sign -- only the dollar weight on each. Built by setup/scripts/sizing_matrix_2026_08_19.py.
n_effective_note: distinct (date, side, setup, 5-min entry bucket) groups across all 5 arms. The arms trade ONE shared signal at r=0.846 / 95.7% sign agreement, so this -- not 303 -- bounds the independent evidence, and for a DAY-level effect the binding number is 35 trading days.

production_reconciliation.note: gross differs by $1.34 (one ledger row rounds -36.99 to -37.00); fees differ by $0.49 because the model charges OCC/ORF once per SIDE and the ledger charges per EXECUTION. The same formula prices every cell, so both cancel out of every delta.

PRODUCTION.description: as traded: core flat min_contracts + fleet equity/elite ladder + risky-3 cheap boost

MINCON-FLAT.description: every arm flat at its own min_contracts (3/3/5/5/5) -- the clamp-always baseline

MINCON-FLAT-2X.description: min_contracts x2 -- pure-leverage control for every x2 tilt below

EQUITY-2%.description: qty = 2% of live equity / notional (constant-dollar risk)

EQUITY-50%.description: qty = 50% of live equity / notional (Rule 6 ceiling, bold/risky)

CONV-SCORE.description: x2 if score>=10, x1 if 8-9, x0.5 if <8

CONV-SCORE-INV.description: inverse of CONV-SCORE (bigger on WEAK signals)

CHEAP-BOOST.description: x2 when entry premium < $0.50 (risky-3's live boost, book-wide)

RICH-BOOST.description: x2 when premium >= $0.50, half when cheap

EARLY-BOOST.description: x2 in the first 60 min after the open

RECENCY-DOWN.description: half size after the arm's prior trading day was red

RECENCY-UP.description: double size after a red day (C31 anti-pattern, priced for completeness)

risky3_cheap_contract_qty_boost.preregistered_kill: n>=10 boosted fills or 10 sessions, net<0 -> delete the two keys

fleet_equity_elite_ladder.mechanism: params.json#position_sizing_tiers -> fleet_executor._qty_for; min_contracts is applied as a CEILING only on a RED recency verdict (_apply_recency_min_sizing, ribbon_ride scope)
fleet_equity_elite_ladder.confound_warning: ladder-passed vs clamped is NOT a clean size A/B -- the clamp fires on RED recency days and the passed population skews to expensive VWAP_CONTINUATION entries, so day-regime, setup and premium are all confounded with size. Direction only.

min_contracts_equity_scaled_DEAD.status: REVERTED 2026-08-14 (commit 636c5ba4); both params files read false today
min_contracts_equity_scaled_DEAD.reading: this money is already banked as a lesson -- it is NOT an available forward improvement, and any counterfactual that 'gains' it is double-counting a closed loop
